remaining_candidate_core.name: cross-fitted evidence-qualified orthogonal increment
remaining_candidate_core.definition: s(d,t)=b(d,t)+a(t)r(d,t), with b frozen from label-disjoint cross-fitting, a determined only by pair-label-independent experimental receptor QC, and r trained only on the residual information not predictable from the base representation

orthogonalization_if_stage0_passes.increment_fit: fit r from z_perp and permitted interactions to u only on qualified evidence rows; do not refit the full label
orthogonalization_if_stage0_passes.target_balance: weight qualified targets so highly assayed targets cannot dominate the residual objective
orthogonalization_if_stage0_passes.fallback: a(t)=0 implies bitwise-identical base logit and rank input before any optional postprocessing

candidate_novelty_is_joint_not_component: cross-fitted projection of both the label and structure feature onto the universal sequence-chemistry information space
exact functional fallback when optional evidence is absent
the same increment audited in both target-to-drug and drug-to-target query directions

promotion_policy.same_data_claim_only: SOTA wording requires the frozen ChEMBL37 split population and identical evaluation pairs; public random or cross-domain headline results remain separate context
